Watch: Intel's historic drop and the broader tech sell-off. Also, keep an eye on the Fed's next move.

Bottom line: Your concentrated tech and leveraged positions are extremely vulnerable right now.

Trim SMCI: The -27.37% PnL and 'SELL' status suggest cutting losses.
